value.reason: The evidence 'products.37.limitPerUser' is a config value for a product catalog. It sets how many units of product 37 one user can buy or claim. This is a business rule, not personal data: it holds no identifier, contact detail, credential or biometric, health or child data about any person. It is labeled Financial only because that is the closest of the required categories, since it relates to purchase and transaction limits. Its sensitivity is low.
